about.heroDescription: Looking to rent or buy property in Rwanda? Discover houses, villas, apartments, land, rooms, offices, shops and commercial properties with TURAHEZA NAWE.
about.trustLine: Property opportunities for renting and buying
about.categoriesDescription: From a single room to commercial property, discover spaces for living, working, buying and investing.
about.introTitle: Connecting people with the right property.
about.introParagraph1: TURAHEZA NAWE is a property marketplace designed to connect property owners, landlords, tenants, buyers and sellers. Our goal is to make it easier to discover available properties and explore opportunities in Rwanda.
about.introParagraph2: Whether you need a family house, a villa, an apartment, a room, land, an office, a shop or commercial space, our marketplace helps you explore different possibilities.
about.introParagraph3: We also feature construction-related services offered through WPD Ltd for clients planning building projects.
about.galleryDescription: Explore examples of residential, business and land opportunities.

gallery.housesText: Find a place to call home.
gallery.landText: Explore land for your next investment.

about.servicesDescription: For clients planning to develop property, explore the construction-related services available through WPD Ltd.

services.permitText: Assistance preparing construction permit applications and supporting documents required for applicable approvals.
services.constructionText: Construction services for building projects according to agreed plans, specifications and project requirements.
services.supervisionText: Monitoring progress, workmanship and quality against approved drawings and project specifications.
services.drawingsText: Building plans and architectural drawings to help clients plan and visualize their projects.
services.landAdviceText: Guidance on land suitability, location, access and planning considerations before purchasing or developing land.
services.environmentText: Environmental assessment support to identify potential impacts and prepare relevant documentation.
services.estimationText: Estimating construction material quantities to support budgeting, purchasing and project planning.
services.specificationsText: Technical requirements describing materials, workmanship and standards for construction projects.

about.servicesCtaDescription: Visit WPD Ltd for more information about construction and technical services.
about.videoTitle: From an empty site to a completed home.
about.videoDescription: Watch a construction walkthrough covering important stages of building a house, including foundations, structure, installations and finishing.
about.valuesDescription: The principles behind our property marketplace.

values.trustText: We aim to make property information clearer so clients can make informed decisions.
values.connectText: We connect property owners, landlords, buyers, tenants and other property seekers.
values.customerText: We make it easier to discover property opportunities that match different needs.

about.teamDescription: Contact our team for business, property and technical enquiries.
about.bottomTitle: Ready to find your next property?
about.bottomDescription: Start exploring homes, land, offices, shops and commercial spaces available through our marketplace.
